metadata.event: 48th General Assembly — Overture 37 Recorded Negative Votes
metadata.identity_rule: Printed office, name, and presbytery are preserved from the official minutes; canonical IDs are resolved only through the conservative identity layer.
metadata.vote_semantics: A recorded negative vote establishes opposition to the final adopted Overture 37 recommendation at the 48th General Assembly. It does not establish the commissioner’s rationale or position on every related overture.
metadata.procedural_vote_guardrail: The immediately preceding 1349-443 tally was the motion to close debate and is not the Overture 37 adoption tally.
